title: Contract Pricing Agreement Price Claim Desk Reference: Windows, Minimums and Authority by Tier
content:
Contract price claims on the Contract Pricing Agreement run on four tier figures: the claim window, the smallest claim amount processed, the support desk's approval authority and the decision time.

Columns, lowest tier to highest: **Account Price Schedule** = Corbett Account Price Schedule; **Volume Discount** = Corbett Volume Discount Agreement; **Category Contract** = Corbett Category Contract; **Net-Price** = Corbett Net-Price Contract; **Cost-Plus** = Corbett Cost-Plus Contract; **Strategic Supply** = Corbett Strategic Supply Agreement.

| Term | Account Price Schedule | Volume Discount | Category Contract | Net-Price | Cost-Plus | Strategic Supply |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Claim window: calendar days after the invoice date within which a claim is accepted | 60 | 60 | 90 | 90 | 120 | 180 |
| Smallest claim amount processed (USD); a smaller difference is not credited | 5.00 | 5.00 | 2.00 | 1.00 | 1.00 | 0.01 |
| Largest claim amount the support desk approves without Pricing Desk review (USD) | 100.00 | 250.00 | 500.00 | 1000.00 | 2500.00 | 5000.00 |
| Business days within which a filed price claim is decided | 10 | 10 | 7 | 5 | 5 | 3 |

| Claim amount compared with the tier figures | Band |
|---|---|
| Below the smallest claim amount | Not credited |
| From the smallest claim amount up to and including the desk authority | Within the support desk's authority |
| Above the desk authority | Beyond the support desk's authority; Pricing Desk review |

Hypothetical example: on a tier with a desk authority of 500.00, a claim of exactly 500.00 is within the desk's authority and a claim of 500.01 is not. (Illustrative figures.)
